manual_review.api_and_imports: Three public export signatures retained; every import identity from imports.json retained, including public type names. Limits and schema-derived result types remain imported opaque owners; none are recreated.
manual_review.phases: Undefined or empty array returns undefined. Slice uses original maxPhases and map builds fresh ordered records and array below or above cap. Optional enteredAt/exitedAt follow required order and omit only undefined.
manual_review.subagents: Slice uses original maxSubagents; map builds fresh records in original order. Outer result keys are subagents then truncated, with strict kept-length comparison. Empty, below-cap, exact-cap, and above-cap thought cases give fresh empty/kept arrays and false/false/false/true truncation respectively.
manual_review.nested_identity: Each present ask, lastTool, wait, and concurrency is rebuilt by an object literal enumerating only its listed keys. No source record is returned or spread. Extra nested and outer keys cannot enter the projection.
manual_review.order_and_omission: Object literals and conditional property spreads follow the contract field sequence. All optional fields use !== undefined. Absent optional fields have no own keys; present zero/false/empty-string values are copied. Ask turn/toolCalls have no defaults.
manual_review.health: Optional progress/stall/concurrency precede required failure/cache fields, then optional leftoverRunning, then pendingQuestionsKnown. leftoverRunning undefined or strictly zero is omitted; other supplied values are retained. Zero timings, empty reason, and false pendingQuestionsKnown survive.
manual_review.value_and_input_preservation: No sorting, validation, coercion, trimming, escaping, field clipping, or input writes. Strings and primitive values are copied unchanged, including long or empty public values. slice/map create arrays without changing input arrays.
manual_review.required_data: Original module strings, wait type-index string, and four zero literals are preserved as necessary public API/sentinel syntax. Public schema/static initializer material stays with its imported original owner; it is not rewritten here.
